from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 10:33 2021 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 3 - 6 June 2021 Technical Delegate's Report A seal was broken on the gearbox of car number 31, driver Esteban Ocon, in order to change the hydraulic differential clutch pack actuator. This was done in accordance with Article 9.5.2 of the 2021 FIA Formula One Technical Regulations. Last night team personnel of the Alpine F1 Team team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eight hour period which commenced at 00:30 on 05 June, twelve and a half hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 10:00 on 05 June. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Alpine F1 Team team during the 2021 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
title: Gearbox Issue And Curfew
